name: Christlikeness
overview: Scripture reveals that true Christlikeness is rooted in the indwelling presence of the Spirit of Christ, marking believers as His own (Romans 8:9). God’s purpose for His people is transformation into the image of His Son, Jesus, who is the firstborn among many brothers (Romans 8:29). This growth involves maturing in truth and love under Christ’s headship (Ephesians 4:15), while actively working out salvation with reverence and diligence (Philippians 2:12). Ultimately, Christ’s authority as Creator of all things underscores the believer’s call to reflect His character and lordship in every aspect of life (Colossians 1:16).
